full_details: The morning was the desk. You set one word under Sunday's blow, and you did not start the speech around it. The almanac had the moon drawn new. At twenty to eleven my lord of Southampton called from Holborn, where he is for two nights, with Florio frowning at his elbow. He called poems left for players a desertion. You told him the players pay by the week. He asked for fourteen lines to send with a pair of gloves, for a lady he did not name. She mocks him. You told him of the friar. You gave no verse, and you promised none. At two you played Egeon. Before you came off, George Bryan told you what a Carey groom had said. My lord courts Mistress Vernon, one of the Queen's maids, with too much familiarity, and the court says so. You did not better the sentence. At home you said he was happy, and that not a leaf in the drawer would fit. You wrote nothing for it.
one_sentence: You wrote one word under the blow, and Southampton asked you for fourteen lines.
title: Wrote one word and heard Southampton ask for fourteen lines
